Collins Aerospace develops technologically advanced solutions for the aerospace and defense industry, with Raytheon Applied Signal Technology providing strategic and tactical SIGINT solutions. The Infrastructure Engineer I will work on collaborative, cross-disciplinary teams to design, develop, test, integrate, deploy, and support complex software and systems solutions, including Linux-based infrastructure and field deployments.

Responsibilities
Work on complex technical problems and provide solutions which are highly innovative while participating on collaborative, cross-disciplined integrated product teams
Once cleared, work on actual field deployments of the product under development, ensuring proper setup, configuration, and functionality of systems being deployed
Work will be performed with guidance of a product lead and team members who will assist in establishing an approach, perform code review and support in testing to achieve long-range goals and objectives
